note: Plan 0026, R12: the texture sets of the ground and the walls of the showcase of Bãi Trước. Each set is a Poly Haven asset (CC0). tools/look/textures.py gets the maps (diffuse, normal, roughness, 1k) to assets/textures/look/ID/ and writes assets/textures/look/manifest.json; --check compares the files with the manifest (no network). The manifest has the side of each texture on the ground (size_m, from the dimensions of the asset). The choice of each set is a builder choice from the photos of section 3 and the photo from a drone of 2021; I approve it with the shots of PT-72.

sets.uses: The sidewalks of Quang Trung and Hạ Long: grey and white tiles in a checker pattern (the photo from a drone of 2021-01-30).
The walk of the sea and the paved squares of the park: slabs of stone (the photos of S5, 2014 and 2015).
The borders of the paths, the raised lawns, the low wall along the beach, and the sea wall of Hạ Long: granite (the photos of S5, 2014).
The stand-ins of the buildings that World does not have yet: painted plaster.
